senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; fr. לחח to chew, v. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v. לוע) food, bread; [Arab. meat].
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> the benediction over bread (<cite ref="Q02110"><he>פת</he></cite>) reads: <he>המוציא ל׳ וכ׳</he> who makest food grow out of the earth; <cite ref="Berakhot 37b:13">ib. 37ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 11:1">Men. XI, 1</cite> <he>שתי הל׳</he> (sub. <he>ככרות</he>) the two loaves of bread (<cite ref="Leviticus 23:17">Lev. XXIII, 17</cite>).
Ib. ל׳ הפנים the show-bread (on the table of the Sanctuary); a. fr.—Trnsf. tribute, tax, salary (cmp. annona).
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite> <he>זו לַחְמָהּ של מלכות</he> that is (thou shalt partake of) the royal maintenance.
<cite ref="Zevachim 85a">Zeb. 85ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Meilah 7b:9">Meïl. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>לַחְמוֹ של מזבח</he> the tribute belonging to the altar (cmp.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:8:3">Y. Ḥag. III, end, 79ᵈ</cite> <he>שני ל׳</he> two sets of show-bread, opp. to <he>לחם אחד</he>.
